## 2. Value Proposition

Universal Dynamic exists to close the gap between where a small business starts and where it needs to be — legally registered, federally compliant, and online with a fast, modern presence that belongs entirely to the owner.

Core offers:
1. Self-hosted Google Cloud / Firebase websites with Day-1 admin key transfer and ~$0/month base hosting for standard traffic.
2. Zero monthly agency fees after delivery (clients pay Google for hosting, not an agency retainer).
3. Turnkey Texas business setup: Texas Secretary of State entity filings, IRS EIN, SAM.gov / UEI / CAGE readiness.

---

## 3. Services Detail

### Self-Hosted Google Cloud Websites
- Deployed into the client's own Google Cloud / Firebase project.
- 100% administrative ownership transferred on Day 1.
- Performance-oriented static / SSG architecture aimed at excellent Core Web Vitals.
- Includes plain-English handoff training and typically 2 months of concierge support.
- Canonical overview: https://universal-dynamic.com/

### Texas SOS & Entity Filings
- Texas Secretary of State business entity filings and formation support.
- IRS Employer Identification Number (EIN) registration assistance.
- Structured for local entrepreneurs launching in Texas.

### SAM.gov & Federal Contracting Readiness
- Complete SAM.gov entity registration and profile setup.
- Unique Entity ID (UEI) and CAGE code onboarding support.
- Positions businesses for government contract eligibility.

### Local Web Design & SEO (Lake Jackson / 77566)
- Hyper-local service page: https://universal-dynamic.com/services/lake-jackson-tx
- Custom self-hosted sites optimized for Lake Jackson and surrounding Brazoria County search.

---

## 4. Ownership Model

Unlike traditional web agencies that retain platform control and charge monthly retainers:

- Clients receive full admin ownership of Google Cloud, Firebase hosting, domain DNS, and related Workspace assets on Day 1.
- No proprietary CMS lock-in and no permanent agency seat.
- Hosting costs go to Google at near-$0 base for typical small-business traffic.
- Compared with common agency retainers, clients can avoid roughly $1,800–$3,600 per year in recurring platform/agency fees.
